tasks.short: Store, retrieve and transfer controlled part patterns and programs

steps.what: Identify the required part, program revision and intended retrieval or storage operation
inputs: actual job requirement
existing controlled part and program identifiers
outputs: programmer-confirmed part, revision and operation

steps.what: Locate the exact existing pattern, graphic display or program in the controlled library
inputs: programmer-confirmed part, revision and operation
existing controlled library metadata
outputs: located candidate file with identity and revision

steps.what: Enter the retrieval command and open the located file without changing its controlled source
inputs: located candidate file with identity and revision
outputs: retrieved pattern, graphic or program file

steps.what: Check that the retrieved content matches the required part and revision
inputs: retrieved pattern, graphic or program file
programmer-confirmed part, revision and operation
outputs: content-checked exact source file

steps.what: Prepare and check the exact storage or transfer command, file and intended medium or destination
inputs: content-checked exact source file
actual authorized destination and media requirements
outputs: complete checked file-transfer payload and destination

steps.what: Execute the checked storage or media-transfer command
inputs: complete checked file-transfer payload and destination
outputs: stored or transferred exact file and command result

tasks.design: Configure saved part-and-revision searches in {OTHER}, the existing controlled CAM/program library. The programmer verifies content and the exact destination before executing a storage or transfer command; command execution and file-copy runtime earn no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the correct revision may require repeated library navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native indexed metadata and saved searches can narrow existing library results.
tasks.human_edge: Confirm the actual program and intended destination.

ambition.what: Reduce library navigation without automatic program release.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: controlled CAM/program libraries can search part and revision metadata; users must verify program identity and transfer destination.

assumptions: OTHER is the existing CAM/program library and file-transfer interface. Existing controlled files and their authors supply metadata; no new tagging baseline or inferred revision is assumed.
Native saved search first. Scenario includes retrieval followed by a requested internal storage/media transfer, not loading a machine for execution. Save/transfer command time is 1% fully retained.
Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. Gross 5 minus 0.5 search upkeep gives 4.5 net. If searches already suffice, no saving.
unknowns: Actual library navigation burden and metadata completeness
research_questions: Can a native saved search reduce observed lookup while preserving part/revision certainty?

already_counted.description: Check narrowed library results against required identity

approvals.approved_version: exact file, command and destination checked at end of s5; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if existing search adequate; cautious range below provisional 4.5% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Revise erroneous CNC programs and retest the fixes

steps.what: Diagnose actual program errors using the part specification, failed test and machine/setup context
inputs: actual failed program and test findings
authoritative part specification
actual tooling and setup data
outputs: programmer's identified error and correction requirements

steps.what: Revise the erroneous operations or parameters and regenerate the affected NC program
inputs: programmer's identified error and correction requirements
actual failed program and test findings
approved CAM operation templates and postprocessor
outputs: revised NC program candidate

steps.what: Retest the revised candidate in simulation against the actual part, tools and setup, including collision and gouge checks
inputs: revised NC program candidate
authoritative part specification
actual tooling and setup data
outputs: actual simulation findings for the exact revised candidate

steps.what: Check the exact simulated program and controlled retest setup, accepting only a clean candidate for the test load
inputs: actual simulation findings for the exact revised candidate
revised NC program candidate
actual tooling and setup data
outputs: programmer-accepted exact controlled-test program and destination

steps.what: Load only the accepted exact program to the controlled retest destination
inputs: programmer-accepted exact controlled-test program and destination
outputs: exact revised program loaded for controlled retest

steps.what: Conduct the controlled retest and inspect actual results to establish whether the original problem is solved
inputs: exact revised program loaded for controlled retest
authoritative part specification
actual tooling and setup data
outputs: actual retest and inspection evidence for the revised version

steps.what: Check the actual retest evidence and exact version for release, retaining failures for another correction cycle
inputs: actual retest and inspection evidence for the revised version
revised NC program candidate
outputs: checked exact release candidate with verified problem resolution, or explicit hold

steps.what: Release the exact checked program version only when the retest has passed
inputs: checked exact release candidate with verified problem resolution, or explicit hold
outputs: released corrected program version or retained hold

tasks.design: Use native operation templates and the validated postprocessor in {OTHER} to regenerate only the corrected operations. Keep simulation, controlled retesting in {OPS_SYSTEM}, actual result inspection and exact-version release with the programmer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Hand-editing repeated operation blocks can introduce another error during correction.
tasks.enabler_now: Native CAM parameter edits and controlled regeneration can reuse validated operation definitions.
tasks.still_hard: Find the real error and establish that the actual retest solved it.
tasks.human_edge: Interpret machine/setup context and reject an apparently clean but incorrect fix.

ambition.what: Reduce repetitive correction coding without bypassing retesting.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-7; CAM and controls-owner approval and programmer consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: CAM templates and postprocessors regenerate NC code deterministically; simulation and actual controlled retesting remain necessary to verify corrections.

assumptions: OTHER is existing CAM, simulation and controlled program storage; OPS_SYSTEM is the controlled machine test interface. Actual test findings, approved part geometry and setup supply inputs. Programmer diagnoses and specifies the correction in s1.

Native regeneration first, no model-written machine code. One successful correction cycle is a provisional scenario; failure returns to diagnosis, with no test load after failed simulation and no release after failed retest.

Shares are unmeasured. Gross 6 minus 1 template/postprocessor upkeep gives 5 net. Simulation runtime, machine runtime and 1% load/release commands earn no saving. Existing test acceptance checks are retained, not an added self-approval layer for an ordinary note.
unknowns: Existing regeneration use and correction cycles required in practice
research_questions: Can native regeneration reduce actual repetitive edits without changing simulator or first-article checks?

already_counted.description: Review regenerated operations and accept exact tested versions

incremental.description: Maintain operation templates and validate postprocessor changes

approvals.approved_version: exact clean-simulated program and controlled-test destination accepted at end of s4; edits void acceptance
exact program version accepted against actual passed retest at end of s7; edits void acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if native regeneration already used; cautious range below provisional 5% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Modify CNC programs to improve machining efficiency

steps.what: Review actual cycle observations and the existing program to identify the limiting operation
inputs: actual cycle observations and available timing data
existing controlled program
part and setup requirements
outputs: programmer's identified efficiency opportunity with constraints

steps.what: Choose an appropriate operation or parameter modification within actual tooling and part constraints
inputs: programmer's identified efficiency opportunity with constraints
approved tooling data and operation rules
outputs: programmer-selected efficiency modification

steps.what: Modify the selected operations and regenerate the candidate program using the approved CAM definitions
inputs: programmer-selected efficiency modification
existing controlled program
approved CAM operations and postprocessor
outputs: modified efficiency candidate program

steps.what: Simulate and inspect the exact modified candidate, accepting a controlled test only after checks pass
inputs: modified efficiency candidate program
part and setup requirements
approved tooling data and operation rules
outputs: clean-simulation accepted exact candidate and test destination, or hold

steps.what: Load the accepted exact candidate to the controlled test destination
inputs: clean-simulation accepted exact candidate and test destination, or hold
outputs: exact efficiency candidate loaded for controlled testing or held

steps.what: Run the controlled trial and compare actual cycle performance and part quality against the requirements
inputs: exact efficiency candidate loaded for controlled testing or held
actual cycle observations and available timing data
part and setup requirements
outputs: actual trial quality and efficiency results

steps.what: Record and check actual trial results and the exact release candidate, or retain the prior program if the change fails
inputs: actual trial quality and efficiency results
modified efficiency candidate program
outputs: complete checked release package and decision supported by actual trial

steps.what: Commit the checked program release package only when the actual trial supports the change
inputs: complete checked release package and decision supported by actual trial
outputs: controlled efficiency revision or explicit retained prior version

tasks.design: Use native operation editing and deterministic program regeneration in {OTHER}. The programmer selects the change from actual cycle evidence, simulates it, tests it through {OPS_SYSTEM} and releases only the version supported by actual trial results.
tasks.previous_blocker: Implementing an efficiency choice may require repetitive operation edits.
tasks.enabler_now: Approved CAM operation definitions and postprocessors can regenerate affected code.
tasks.still_hard: Improve cycle performance without harming tool behavior or part quality.
tasks.human_edge: Judge the actual constraint and interpret controlled trial results.

ambition.what: Reduce coding effort; machining cycle savings are a different metric.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: CAM operation regeneration can reduce repeated edits, while simulation and trial inspection establish whether an efficiency modification works.

assumptions: OTHER is CAM, simulation and controlled program storage; OPS_SYSTEM is the existing machine test interface. Actual existing cycle evidence and programmer analysis produce the change requirements; absent timing data is not invented.
Native CAM configuration first; no language model selects feeds or writes executable code. One trial is a provisional scenario, not an observed baseline. Failed simulation or trial stops release.
Gross programming-labor saving is 5 minus 1 template/postprocessor upkeep = 4 net. Machine cycle improvement is not counted as human labor. Load and release commands are 1% each, fully retained.
unknowns: Actual repetitive edit effort and current native CAM use
research_questions: Can operation regeneration reduce programmer effort while retaining the same simulation and actual trial checks?

already_counted.description: Review regenerated candidate and actual release evidence

incremental.description: Maintain operation definitions and postprocessor validation

approvals.approved_version: exact clean-simulated candidate and test destination accepted at end of s4; edits void acceptance
complete release package checked against actual trial at end of s7; edits void acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if regeneration already native; cautious range below provisional 4% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Enter hole-location coordinates into program memory

steps.what: Read the actual hole geometry and revision from the authoritative part drawing or CAD model
inputs: authoritative designer-issued part geometry and revision
outputs: programmer-checked hole geometry and source revision

steps.what: Establish and enter the actual program datum, units and coordinate transformation for the setup
inputs: programmer-checked hole geometry and source revision
actual setup datum and orientation
outputs: programmer-specified datum, units and transformation

steps.what: Enter the hole-location coordinates into the candidate program using supported CAD feature import rather than repeated button entry
inputs: programmer-checked hole geometry and source revision
programmer-specified datum, units and transformation
outputs: candidate program hole-coordinate table

steps.what: Check every imported hole location, datum, orientation and unit against the actual part and setup requirements
inputs: candidate program hole-coordinate table
programmer-checked hole geometry and source revision
programmer-specified datum, units and transformation
outputs: complete checked exact coordinate-memory payload and destination

steps.what: Commit the exact checked coordinates to the intended program memory without executing machining
inputs: complete checked exact coordinate-memory payload and destination
outputs: stored checked hole-location coordinates

tasks.design: Use supported native CAD hole-feature import in {OTHER} with the programmer's explicit datum and unit settings. The programmer verifies all coordinates before committing the exact table to {OPS_SYSTEM}; no imported table starts the machine.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated button or pedal entry duplicates existing hole geometry and can transpose coordinates.
tasks.enabler_now: Compatible CAM/controller workflows can import geometry and transform coordinates deterministically.
tasks.still_hard: Establish the actual setup datum and catch a valid-looking but wrong coordinate frame.
tasks.human_edge: Match the digital geometry to the real setup.

ambition.what: Replace verified coordinate re-entry where native import is supported.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: compatible CAD/CAM workflows can import hole geometry and transform coordinates using explicit datum and units; programmers must verify setup correspondence.

assumptions: OTHER is CAD/CAM; OPS_SYSTEM is programmer/controller memory. Designer-issued digital geometry supplies hole locations; s2 counts actual setup datum capture. No hidden typed coordinate list, model-read drawing or inferred datum.

Native import first and only if compatible. A legacy pedal-only programmer or paper-only geometry retains manual entry and has zero saving. This task ends at coordinate storage; validation for machining release is not claimed completed.
Shares are unmeasured provisional scenarios. Gross 24 minus 2 import-setting upkeep gives 22 net. Coordinate verification is fully retained and the 1% memory commit carries no saving.
unknowns: Actual programmer import support and authoritative digital geometry availability
research_questions: Can the native import preserve every hole, unit and setup datum with less observed entry effort?

already_counted.description: Review imported coordinate table and verify actual setup correspondence

incremental.description: Maintain import settings and challenge datum/unit transformations after updates

approvals.approved_version: exact coordinate table and destination checked at end of s4; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero for incompatible legacy equipment or absent digital geometry; cautious range below provisional 22% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
